prompts.title: 电影般的冬季场景提示：情侣扔雪
prompts.description: 以下是为 Gemini 上的 Nano Banana Pro 设计的详细提示，描述了雪林中充满活力的冬季场景。它描绘了一对年轻夫妇在玩耍时扔雪，强调了动感、自发性和电影般的氛围。提示中明确了人物的服装（泰迪熊外套、针织帽、阔腿裤）、拍摄角度（低角度，向右倾斜）以及技术细节，如浅景深（f/2.8）和调色板（暖米色/棕色与冷白色形成对比）。
prompts.prompt: A dynamic winter scene in a snowy forest, featuring a young couple playfully throwing show at each other on a wide forest path. The camera is positioned low and slightly angled to the right, facing the couple, capturing motion and spontaneity. In the foreground, a young woman in a long, {argument name="coat color" default="light brown"} teddy coat, white knit bat, white wide-leg pants, warm mittens, and beige boots reacts as a cloud of snow hits her, her posture animated and lively, one arm slightly raised, showing a mix of surprise and joy on her face. In the background, a young man in blue jeans, brown boots, light sweater with beige and white stripes, and a white beanie is mid-throw, his figure slightly blurred to emphasize motion. Both are surrounded by tall, dark pine trees dusted with snow, creating a cozy, cinematic atmosphere. The ground is completely covered with fresh, untouched snow. The overall mood is playful, youthful, and joyful, with an energetic winter vibe. Lighting is soft, ambient daylight, diffused through the forest canopy. The photo is captured with a shallow depth of field (f/2.8), focusing on the woman in the foreground while slightly blurring the background to highlight movement and atmosphere. Colors are natural and muted, with warm beige and brown tones contrasting against cold whites and forest greens. The composition emphasizes activity, emotional connection, and visual storytelling, ideal for high quality editorial or lifestyle winter photography.

prompts.description: 给 Nano Banana Pro 的提示：创作一张大胆的竖版音乐海报，画面中一位女歌手正在现场表演。图像应采用粗犷的单色处理，带细微颗粒感，但需在图像上叠加充满活力的霓虹绿色调，背景为纹理化的青绿色，并配有超大黄色字体拼写“ROCK STAR”。
prompts.prompt: Create a bold, high-energy vertical music poster featuring a young female singer performing live on stage. She is captured mid-performance, holding a microphone close to her mouth, smiling with confidence and charisma. Her hair is styled in messy space buns with loose strands, and she wears an oversized black t-shirt layered with chunky chain necklaces, giving a rebellious, effortless stage presence. The portrait is treated in gritty monochrome with subtle grain and texture, while neon green accents are painted over parts of the image—especially flame-like graphic shapes rising from the bottom of her shirt—adding intensity and visual punch. The background is a flat, textured teal-green surface with visible noise and poster grain. Dominating the composition behind the subject is oversized, rounded, bold yellow typography spelling out "{argument name="text" default="ROCK STAR"}" in stacked lines. The letters are thick, playful, and slightly retro, filling most of the frame and partially obscured by the performer to create depth. Place her name behind the figure.
